project.name: TACS_Projeto_G7_-_Problem_Metamodel
project.description: Modern workspace project for UML, GUI and quantum modeling.

c5fc683a-024c-4f82-89db-44e33a4ea2ab.name: BoxSizePositive
c5fc683a-024c-4f82-89db-44e33a4ea2ab.description: The size of the boxes must be positive

08580f2f-f15b-4f58-89c1-dd046dbd742d.name: SizeConsistent
08580f2f-f15b-4f58-89c1-dd046dbd742d.description: The size of the board must be the sizes of the boxes squared.
08580f2f-f15b-4f58-89c1-dd046dbd742d.constraint: context Board  inv SizeConsistent: self.size = self.boxSize * self.boxSize

2457c27f-24b2-43f4-a1f6-f3faac2c6d6d.description: The cell must be given on not
2457c27f-24b2-43f4-a1f6-f3faac2c6d6d.constraint:
context Cell
inv GivenFlagValid: self.isGiven = True or self.isGiven = False

73e3110e-5fa9-48ee-8b7f-bf6d41819fc6.description: The amount of cells must be equal to size squared
73e3110e-5fa9-48ee-8b7f-bf6d41819fc6.constraint:
context Board
inv CellCount: self.cell->size() = self.size * self.size

171a1ab2-8bd1-4132-950b-372f0550c3f6.description: Each cell has an unique position
171a1ab2-8bd1-4132-950b-372f0550c3f6.constraint:
context Board
inv UniquePositions: self.cell->forAll(c1, c2 | c1 <> c2 implies (c1.row <> c2.row or c1.column <> c2.column))

ceb419e8-d028-487e-93c4-7ac693167e2a.description: Different cells in the same row, column or box must have different value, as long as they are not empty
ceb419e8-d028-487e-93c4-7ac693167e2a.constraint:
context Board
inv ConsistentValues: self.cell->forAll(c1, c2 | (c1 <> c2 and not c1.value.oclIsUndefined() and not c2.value.oclIsUndefined() and (c1.row = c2.row or c1.column = c2.column or c1.box = c2.box)) implies c1.value <> c2.value)

90e5354e-69af-414d-8831-cb99859efe83.description: The column and row fo the cell must be valid
90e5354e-69af-414d-8831-cb99859efe83.constraint:
context Cell
inv PositionValid: self.row >= 0 and self.row < self.board.size and self.column >= 0 and self.column < self.board.size

954d17f9-521c-47de-b5c2-8edd877b94e7.description: The cell value must be empty or be between 1 and board size
954d17f9-521c-47de-b5c2-8edd877b94e7.constraint:
context Cell
inv ValueValid: self.value.oclIsUndefined() or (self.value >= 1 and self.value <= self.board.size)

674ef263-cf44-46ed-9500-f0a80ea35471.constraint: context Cell inv BoxCoherent: self.box = (self.row / self.board.boxSize).floor() * self.board.boxSize + (self.column / self.board.boxSize).floor()
